title: BACS direct debit reversal processed.
description: Bankers' Automated Clearing System (BACS) transaction event data. BACS is a UK service that facilitates electronic money transfers between banks within a 3-day settlement cycle — day 1 (submission), day 2 (processing), and day 3 (clearing). This event represents a BACS direct debit reversal: the originator of a direct debit collected from a Pismo account reverses it, and the collected amount is credited back to the payer. It is emitted once, when the reversal received from the provider (Form3) is recorded, with status `SETTLED` or `CANCELLED`.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Account ID of the payer whose direct debit was reversed

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Provider reversal ID, used for idempotency

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: Provider reversal ID. You can use this to link the transaction in our system to the provider's transaction.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Reference of the direct debit being reversed

mandate_id.title: Mandate ID
mandate_id.description: ID of the mandate the reversed direct debit was collected against. Omitted when the direct debit being reversed is not found.

scheme_unique_id.title: Scheme ID
scheme_unique_id.description: Internal BACS transaction ID. BACS does not guarantee this field is unique and warns the format is subject to change

scheme_payment_type.title: Scheme payment type
scheme_payment_type.description: BACS payment type of the direct debit being reversed, as reported by the provider

processing_date.title: Processing date
processing_date.description: Processing date of the original direct debit being reversed (day 3 of the BACS cycle). Populated by Provider, which does not report a separate processing date for the reversal itself. Empty string when not available.

clearing_id.title: Clearing ID
clearing_id.description: BACS payment originator Service User Number (SUN) of the direct debit being reversed - numeric 6-digit value. Omitted when the direct debit being reversed is not found.

status.title: Status
status.description: Transaction status. `SETTLED` means the payer was credited back. `CANCELLED` means no funds moved: the provider rejected the reversal, the direct debit being reversed was not settled, or the direct debit being reversed was not found.

creation_date_time.title: Creation date time
creation_date_time.description: Reversal creation datetime, as reported by the provider

update_date_time.title: Update date time
update_date_time.description: Reversal settlement datetime, as reported by the provider. Equal to `creation_date_time` when the provider does not report one.

DebtorAccount.title: Debtor account
DebtorAccount.description: Payer account information, the account credited back by the reversal

CreditorAccount.title: Creditor account
CreditorAccount.description: Originator account information. All fields are empty strings when the direct debit being reversed is not found.

amount.title: amount
amount.description: Transaction amount. When the direct debit being reversed is found, this is its collected amount.
